prompts.text:
A one-take vertical phone video: a red-brick garden path on an overcast day, an old black iron lamp post on the left, leafy hedges and red-leaf shrubs along the path, a pale grey sky. Photoreal, natural skin and natural colors, not CGI, not a cartoon. A playful, goofy, wholesome dance between two friends.

DANCER 1 is the person in [Image 1] and DANCER 2 is the person in [Image 2], in every frame: each has the exact face from their own photo (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), with the clothes from their own photo.
DANCER 1 is the one in front at the start, who dances on the lamp post. THE TWO NEVER TRADE PLACES: DANCER 1 stays on the LEFT side of the pair (the lamp-post side) and DANCER 2 stays on the RIGHT side (the hedge side) for the WHOLE clip, even while they spin, hug and the camera moves. Both are in every frame. Never blend their faces, never swap their clothes. Each face stays the same from the first frame to the last, so their friends recognize them at once. If an image shows an animal, that dancer is that animal standing upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

BEAT BY BEAT:
[00:00-00:01] MOVING FROM THE VERY FIRST FRAME: DANCER 1 stands right in front of the lens, face big and sharp, reaching one hand toward the camera with a big grin, then backs away up the path; DANCER 2 stands behind, bobbing to the beat.
[00:01-00:02.5] DANCER 1 backs up to the lamp post and grabs it with one hand; DANCER 2 throws one hand up over their head and dances in place.
[00:02.5-00:04] DANCER 1 swings around the lamp post, holding on with one hand and leaning out, one foot off the ground, like the lamp post swing in an old movie musical; DANCER 2 steps in close and puts both hands on DANCER 1's shoulders.
[00:04-00:05] the two lean together, swaying, then DANCER 1 swings out from the lamp post with one arm stretched out wide.
[00:05-00:07] they dance face to face, hands up and touching, swaying like dance partners and laughing: DANCER 1 on the LEFT nearer the lamp post, DANCER 2 on the RIGHT, never swapping sides.
[00:07-00:10] the camera drifts right and back down the path as they keep dancing together, DANCER 1 still on the LEFT; at the end DANCER 1 hops in and hugs DANCER 2 against the hedge, both laughing, both faces turned three-quarters to the camera.

ONE continuous vertical 9:16 overcast daytime shot, no cuts, a handheld phone camera at chest height that drifts right and back at the end, the same light throughout. Both full bodies in view, both faces sharp and clearly lit.

Audio: an original playful, bouncy swing tune with light brass and finger snaps, soft steps on the bricks, a burst of laughter at the hug. No dialogue throughout the entire video, no lyrics.

No frozen or still opening, no swapping places or sides, no swapping faces or clothes, no third person, no extra arms or legs, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no extra cuts, no morphing, no distortion.
